newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mainly softer in thin volume.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mainly softer in thin volume.

text.p: NWE oil products were mainly easier in weak volume on Monday, traders said.
High sulphur cracked fuel oil barges fell a couple of dollars and traded at $114-116 a tonne fob NWE.
Prompt Eurograde gasoline barges traded at $221 after an earlier deal at $224 a tonne fob ARA. Early Jan was $219/220.
Naphtha similarly lost a few dollars but no trade was reported.
Gas oil slid $3.50 on futures. Barges were mainly stable, with emphasis on possible arbs to Asia and the United States.
